notes.title: COUCH CO-OP FEST: WHAT THE GOLF?
notes.content:
[h2]WHAT THE GOLF? is a part of COUCH CO-OP FEST here on Steam[/h2]

Looking for that next game to boot up with your friends on the couch or other vessels to put your booty on? It could be a chair. You could even sit on the floor. Together.

Anyway, DID YOU KNOW that WHAT THE GOLF? has a local co-op mode? Try to [strike]passive[/strike] aggressively out-golf your best of friends or significant others! 🏌🏼‍♂️🏌🏼‍♀️

As part of this, we have our yummy yummy 66% discount when you purchase the game during the festival.

Don't have anyone to play locally with? Don't worry, you can always play WHAT THE GOLF? by yourself too. More golf for you! But if you want to see how it works, check out this evergreen Let's Play from MarPar: 

[previewyoutube=Riv9pFRMR14;full][/previewyoutube]

Till next time! 👋🏼

xoxo
Triband

notes.title: Patch 20.5.9
notes.content:
Well hello there!

Hope you're all having A December 🎄

The golf... santa... came into our office, drank a few coffees and then fixed a few bugs. Very strange man. Anyways here's some Patch Notes for a cheeky little fix that came early this week!

[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]

[h3]Secret Saw Achievement[/h3]
So sorry for all the distress concerning this bug and achievement! It unlocks retroactively now - [b]but players will still need to enter the main campaign.[/b]

[h3]Computer 03 Achievement didn't unlock[/h3]
It now unlocks retroactively. Maybe there was some issue that stopped it from triggering when it should.
Players will still need to enter the main campaign to trigger this.

[h3]Players get stuck in a [strike]Mario [/strike] little plumber guy level[/h3]
It was breakable by spamming the shoot button so we've not brought in a plumber and disabling input while you’re in the pipe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32091497/40ccf405285c6147ac76b5a8074a74c0a28916b3.gif[/img]

[h1]NEXT EVENT: LET'S PAR-TEE[/h1]
The next event is gonna take place over NEW YEARS 🎉🍾🥂
from December 23rd until Jan 5th

notes.title: It’s finally here 🥲
notes.content:
The long awaited Among Golf Update just landed on Steam. I am very sorry it took so long but I have very good excuses for it (not really):

[list]
[*] Too much traffic on the way 
[*] My dog ate the build 
[*] I lost my car keys 
[*] I was abducted by aliens
[*] My bathtub was leaking 
[*] I got attacked by a capybara 
[*] A bad haircut kept me at home for months 
[*] I was looking for the meaning of life (I found it, it’s golf)
[*] I fell into the rabbit hole
[*] I got rickrolled 
[*] Good things take time (word)
[*] So much to do, so little time (word²)
[/list]

Aaaaanyways, it’s here and I hope you like it, we had a lot of fun making it. There will be more regular new levels to play in the next few months so come back often 👀 and thanks a million for your patience 🙏

notes.title: What The Golf? is getting a free update with 50 new levels to golf holes in
notes.content:
Unorthodox non-sporting game What The Golf? is hitting the green again and bringing a heck of a lot more holes. An upcoming free update is adding 50 new levels and approximately 1000 new holes. The A Hole New World update has already launched on the Apple Arcade and is coming to PC and Switch versions "in the next few weeks," the developers say.

notes.title: WHAT THE GOLF? Steam trading cards are here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32091497/048e0ce5c7ca87da1fc9eb8fe627ff28a04ad1a3.png[/img]

[b]We are happy to announce that WHAT THE GOLF? now has Steam trading cards! [/b]

Earn cards by playing the game and trading with your fellow golf haters. Once you gather a full set you will be able to craft a badge that you can display on your Steam profile. Each badge will earn you random drops containing profile backgrounds and emotes.

Here’s all the items that can be unlocked with trading cards!
[list]
[*][b]Regular badges (Max of 5)[/b]
[*][b]3 WTG related profile backgrounds[/b]
[*][b]Rare Foil badge (1 level)[/b]
[*][b]6 WTG related Emojis! [/b]
[/list]

There are 15 cards in total so do your best to collect them all! 

[b]Happy Hunting![/b]

notes.title: We have fixed golf!
notes.content:
Are anyone ever reading these stream descriptions?
Here are our favorite recipe for quick N easy...
[h2]Banana bread[/h2]

[i]Prep: 10 min  ›  Cook: 35 min  ›  Ready in: 45 min[/i]

[u]Ingredients:[/u]
125g butter
150g caster sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 egg, beaten
2 very ripe bananas, mashed
190g self-raising flour
60ml milk
 

Grease and line a 2lb loaf tin.
Melt butter, sugar and vanilla in a saucepan over a medium heat. 
Remove from heat and add the mashed bananas, mix well. 
Add the egg, mix well.
Stir in the flour and the milk.

Pour into the prepared tin and bake at 170 C / Fan 150 C / Gas 3 for 35 minutes, or until a skewer comes out clean.

There is nothing else but my voice.

You are relaxed. 
You feel good.

But you still hate golf.

notes.title: GAMESCOM here we come
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32091497/e411ec6d0ae9c9188c9a62c5aec4e9dfe1e9ca6e.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32091497/9372542e94cc1c5dc27a65eeb5daec4250311309.gif[/img]

[h1]Great news everyone[/h1]
We are going to GamesCom in Cologne, Germany to spread the gospel.
GamesCom is a consumer show full of games, Germans, and indies.

WHAT THE GOLF? has been selected as one of the games to be in this year's [url=https://youtu.be/4BcOM8CsM5s] Indie Arena Booth[/url] We are super proud to take part (so many great games) and hope to meet fellow golf haters and cosplayers.

In other words...if you don't know what to do on the 21st - 25th of August and happen to be stuck in the middle of Germany, come to [url=http://www.gamescom.global/] Gamescom[/url] Koelnmesse in Cologne, Germany and hate golf with us. 

We have some cool new things to show you ;)
